The Oscillator Is a Lie 0.0.2

Amber

Aliasing/ring-mod oscillator, not a reverb. Raise Blur above zero to hear it.

Knobs

Panel knob Function
1 Warp Pitch offset; latest supplied note says ±2 octaves; CV is V/oct
2 Time Carrier-to-target ratio, 1–8×
3 Blur Output level without clipping; clipping drive when enabled
4 Reflect Low-pass resonance
5 Mix CW: main output; CCW: blend raw modulator left / raw carrier right
6 Atmosphere Low-pass cutoff; minimum tracks target pitch, maximum about 10 kHz

Buttons and gates

Button Function / LED
7 Reverse Carrier waveform: sine blue → triangle magenta → saw yellow → square cyan
8 Freeze Aliasing green ↔ ring-modulation blue
97 Shift + Reverse Clipping: off → before filter white → after filter red
98 Shift + Freeze Mix routing: normal off → main-only left white → main-only right red
78 Reverse / Freeze gates Waveform / mode, per later author notes

Details & sources

  • Top LEDs: pitch/ratio consonance. Lower LEDs: cutoff, resonance and gain.
  • Other CV mappings and audio-input use: undocumented.
  • Later notes change Warp from ±1 to ±2 octaves and add level control;
    their pairing with the 0.0.2 BIN has not been independently verified.

Source: supplied author notes, February 10–11, 2026.
